input.question: Which person or organization did Anderson Diaz-Perez work for?

documents.text: As Dr. Sophia Patel stepped into the humid Guangzhou air, she couldn't help but think of her colleague, Anderson Diaz-Perez. They had collaborated on several projects, and she had always been impressed by his meticulous attention to detail and passion for environmental conservation. It was no wonder he had landed a coveted position at the prestigious South China Institute of Environmental Sciences. Sophia made her way through the bustling streets, weaving past street vendors and cyclists, to the Institute's headquarters. The nondescript building belied the groundbreaking work being done within its walls. She was greeted by the familiar face of Dr. Li, the Institute's director, who ushered her into a cramped but cozy office. As they sipped jasmine tea, Sophia noticed a framed photograph on the shelf behind Dr. Li's desk. It showed a group of researchers, including Anderson, standing proudly in front of a makeshift laboratory in the midst of a lush, tropical forest. The caption read: "SCIES Team, Hainan Island, 2018." Sophia's eyes lingered on Anderson's beaming smile, his dark hair mussed from the humidity. Dr. Li followed her gaze and nodded. "Ah, yes. Anderson was an integral part of our team during the Hainan Island project. His expertise in ecological modeling was instrumental in our research on the impact of coastal development on mangrove ecosystems." Sophia's eyes widened as she recalled the paper they had co-authored on the subject. "I remember that study. The findings were quite alarming, weren't they?" Dr. Li's expression turned somber. "Indeed. The data suggested that unchecked development could lead to the loss of up to 30% of the island's mangrove forests within the next decade. Anderson's work was crucial in helping us understand the long-term consequences of human activities on these fragile ecosystems." As they delved deeper into conversation, Sophia couldn't help but feel a sense of pride knowing that Anderson had played a key role in shaping the Institute's research agenda.
